input.summary:
Yaba Market Store, Household shelf: 1 of 5 planogram SKUs stocked out (Omo Detergent 1kg, 0 of 3 facings); the other four slots read as compliant (80% compliance, planogram share 100%, no unknown products).

Checked inventory before acting. Omo Detergent 1kg has 15 units on hand against a reorder point of 6 — the store already holds more than enough to refill the shelf, so the fix is a SHELF REFILL, not a purchase order. No reorder was created for it. Restock ~9 units (3 facings) from the storeroom.

No other SKU qualified for a reorder: Sunlight (9 on hand), Lux (7) and Close Up (7) are all above their reorder point of 6 and show full facings. One watch item: Dettol Soap 110g is at 4 on hand versus a reorder point of 6, but its shelf slot is full (4 of 4 facings) and the audit is low-confidence, so I did not order against an unreliable reading — flagged it to the manager instead for confirmation on the next visit.

No telemetry was available and no equipment fault was reported, so no technician was dispatched. A manager has been notified by WhatsApp with the refill instruction, the re-check request and the Dettol watch item.

Escalating: audit confidence is 0.37 with a low_conf auditor note, so the photo cannot be trusted. The single stock-out may be inaccurate and apparently-OK slots may be wrong in either direction; a human needs to verify the shelf visually before any ordering decision is made.
